import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from validate import validate
from adaptive2 import run_one
# huge numbers: capacities 1e12, period 1e6 -> chunk capacity 1e18
n=6
links=[[u,v,10**12] for (u,v) in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,4),(4,5),(0,5),(1,3)]]
per=10**6
env=[[l,10**12] for l in range(len(links))]
dem=[[0,10**12],[2,10**12],[5,10**12]]
cmds=[{"op":"load","n":n,"links":links,"bookings":[]},
      {"op":"prepare","id":"p","owner":"o","window":[0,per*2],"period":per,"participants":dem,"envelope":env,"rev":0},
      {"op":"commit","id":"p","owner":"o","rev":0},
      {"op":"audit","at":[per]}]
reps=run_one(cmds)
problems=[]; validate(cmds,reps,problems)
r=reps[1]
print(r.get('status'), len(r.get('plan',{}).get('trees',[])), "trees", len(r.get('plan',{}).get('routes',[])), "routes")
print("commit:", reps[2].get('status'), "audit:", json.dumps(reps[3])[:200])
print("problems", problems)
# tight huge: rate 1 only
env2=[[l,1] for l in range(len(links))]
cmds2=[{"op":"load","n":n,"links":links,"bookings":[]},
       {"op":"prepare","id":"p","owner":"o","window":[0,per*2],"period":per,"participants":dem,"envelope":env2,"rev":0}]
reps2=run_one(cmds2)
problems2=[]; validate(cmds2,reps2,problems2)
print("tight:", reps2[1].get('status'), reps2[1].get('kind',''), str(reps2[1].get('cut'))[:60], problems2)
PYEOF
